title: Knowledge organiser auto-generated per topic
description: Every generated worksheet ships with a one-pager Knowledge Organiser: vocab + diagrams + key questions, mirrored from the same prompt context. Many schools mandate KOs; this makes Adaptly the source.
rationale: User's improvement #16. PR #43 (LessonPlanner v2) added `deriveKnowledgeOrganiser` for MTPs. This PR ships it for every worksheet, available next to the worksheet via a single 'Knowledge organiser' tab in the renderer.
steps: Reuse mtp-v2-enhancements.ts deriveKnowledgeOrganiser: extend it to take a worksheet (instead of an MTP) and derive a KO from it directly. Move to client/src/lib/knowledgeOrganiser.ts as a shared module.
After worksheet generation, async-fire-and-forget a deriveKnowledgeOrganiserFromWorksheet pass; stamp metadata.knowledgeOrganiser = { vocab, keyFacts, stickyQuestions, diagramHints }.
WorksheetRenderer.tsx: add a 'Knowledge organiser' tab (alongside 'Worksheet' / 'Teacher key' if those exist; otherwise a separate button). Renders A3-landscape printable.
Add 'Print KO' to the toolbar. Reuse buildPopupHtml.
acceptance_criteria: Every freshly-generated worksheet has metadata.knowledgeOrganiser populated within 3s of render.
KO tab renders the four sections; Print KO opens an A3 popup.
verification: Manual: generate, switch to KO tab, print.
